reasoning_notes: Genuine risks share: complete or near-complete causal chains (4+ events) with perfect temporal order, multiple independent sources per event (average 3+), geographic spread (6+ regions and/or 10+ sites), and zero or minimal contradicting reports. Top candidates are those with complete chains (C-9, C-39, C-58, C-12) or exceptionally high independent sourcing despite incomplete chains (C-42 with 24 sources, C-28 with 21 sources, C-41 with 22 sources). Artifacts have scattered events across unrelated chains, temporal out-of-order progression, single-source links, or localized concentration. C-46 (scattered across 5 chains), C-1/C-0/C-13 (out of causal order), and C-3/C-5 (weak sourcing, huge temporal gaps) are clear artifacts.
